messages:
deploy-bot: rolling deploy v2.7 -> canary group A at 11:07 UTC. canary health failing: streaming-api and /v1/paging endpoints returning increased 5xx; creating thread for visibility :rotating_light:

alex: i'm oncall — getting paged. looks like streaming handshake timeouts + paging cursor mismatches. digging in logs now.

alex: stacktrace snippet: ```
2028-05-12T11:09:03Z svc=streaming instance=i-09ab error="handshake: unexpected header type=0x07"
2028-05-12T11:09:03Z svc=paging instance=i-03cd warn="cursor-deserialize failed: version mismatch"
```

incident-bot: Incident I-20280512-17 created (severity: high). On-call: alex -> liaising with runtime + sdk. Pagerduty: paged 2 on-call.

cassie: saw the canary diffs — SDK v2.7 changed the streaming header canonicalization to include a signed-header byte. server runtime v2.7 expects it but older clients (v2.6.x) drop it. result: older clients get handshake failure. also a small cursor-format change (base64 url vs std) slipped through.

liam: that explains the cursor errors. are we rolling this to prod or can we stop the rollout?

alex: can we kill the feature flag for the new header and stop canary expansion? flag is `ff/stream/signed-headers` boolean. i can flip for canary group A now.

sre-runbook-bot: runbook 'rollback-or-killflag' recommended for header incompat. steps:
1) toggle ff/stream/signed-headers -> false for all clusters
2) pause rollout and revert to v2.6.9 if issues persist
3) notify customers + create RCA ticket

alex: toggling flag to false for canary A -> `ffctl set ff/stream/signed-headers false --env prod --target canary-A`

deploy-bot: flag change accepted by infra. Propagating...

natalie: support triage: ~12 distinct customer sessions failed in last 15m. 2 customers reported persistent disconnects on dedicated nodes (high priority). CS is notifying them and collecting logs.

cassie: SDK team — we can ship a 2.7-compatible shim in SDK patch, but that will take ~2-3 hours and requires client installs. given customer impact, recommend immediate killflag + rollback of server rollout to 2.6.9.

pm-oliver: +1 to rollback. we need to minimize blast radius and tell sales/CS which customers to call.

liam: initiating rollback to 2.6.9 for canary groups -> if stable, we'll stop the deploy and roll back prod. Command: ```
deployctl rollback --env=prod --release=2.7 --to=2.6.9 --scope=canary-A
```

deploy-bot: rollback job queued (jid=rb-3032102468-1). ETA 4 min. will stream status here.

deploy-bot: rollback completed for canary-A: status=success. health checks returning to baseline for that cluster.

alex: metrics: 5xx on streaming down from 8% -> 0.6% for canary-A within 90s of rollback. paging cursor errors also dropped.

natalie: CS update: informed 2 high customers of rollback; both are on dedicated infra and reported session recovery after ~3m. other customers seeing intermittent reconnects — monitoring.

customersuccess-bot: notifying affected account owners via templated email.

cassie: we'll cut an emergency SDK patch (2.6.10) with backward-compatible header parsing and an opt-in for signed headers. timeline ~2.5 hours. immediate plan: keep flag off and stop rollout until SDK patch released + client uptake.

liam: prod rollout paused globally. setting rollout pause flag: `ffctl pause rollout/v2.7 --reason "client-incompat: signed headers"`

pm-oliver: please prepare a customer-facing blurb and a post-incident note for marketing + sales. also schedule RCA meeting.

alex: handing incident to liam for mitigation & RCA follow-up — alex is going off pager. :white_check_mark:

liam: taking over. assigning RCA to eng-runtime (cassie + rick) and SDK (cassie). assigning doc owner for postmortem: @cassie.

sre-runbook-bot: remediation checklist completed. recommended next steps: 1) verify SDK patch and staged rollout 2) add compatibility tests for header/cursor variants 3) improve deploy gating to include client-version skew checks.

cassie: noted — will add tests and a gating check to release pipeline. I’ll post PR links in the RCA.

incident-bot: Incident I-20280512-17 status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to medium. next update in 2h or on status change.

liam: final note — killflag + rollback averted wider outage. postmortem scheduled for 2028-05-13 15:00 UTC. cc: support, product, sales.

natalie: marking customers as "notified" and collecting final logs for CS escalate.

customersuccess-bot: created ticket CS-2847 and attached customer logs.

liam: closing thread; will update when RCA is published. thanks all for quick responses :heart:
